entities.summary: R. K. Films was an Indian film production company based in R. Studio, a film studio, both established by and named after the Bollywood actor Raj Kapoor. It was headquartered at Chembur, Mumbai. Founded in 1948, one year after India gained independence. It had a rough start, as its first movie, Aag (1948) did not perform well at the box office. Most of the R. Films productions share a common theme of criticising society and depicting love across social divides.
